method: four parallel read-only audit agents plus lead re-review of every changed path and the process/network/storage boundaries; all findings re-verified against source before fixing
not_covered_this_round: python/bzs/evaluation*.py, golden.py, probe*.py, replay.py (offline evaluation tooling; no Windows-native hazard identified, not exercised end-to-end here)
long-running soak/interaction of crawl+map lanes beyond the existing suites
MSan/TSan (not configured upstream); ASan/UBSan deferred to Linux CI per handoff rules
verified_correct_highlights: storage maintenance: exclusive-lock-before-mutation, scratch preflight with typed rowid/content digests, quarantine tightening, refusal set (schema/quarantine/links/space/timeout) all fail-closed
process identity: birth identity (creation FILETIME / boot_id+starttime) checked at every control point; legacy numeric PID records refused; no name-based process kills anywhere
worker RPC: auth/Origin precede body parsing; strict envelope (dup keys incl. escaped, depth, nodes, int64, finite floats, surrogates) with zero side effects before dispatch; credentials never echoed
netguard: numeric-host forms, Unicode host spellings, NAT64/6to4/Teredo recursion, DNS-pinned resolver, per-hop redirect revalidation, proxies disabled

search semantics: in-word substrings, CJK bigrams with exact phrase positions, accented byte-exact terms, field/boolean queries; owner/deletion/publication constraints re-checked in final projection; partial flags honest
thread pools bounded; stop tokens rechecked inside claim transactions; late completions are clean no-ops
open_observations_not_fixed: web.cpp search cache lock is held across a Store transaction; current lock order is cache->store and no deadlock was established, but serialization remains a performance observation requiring same-input profiling before optimization.
politeness sleep can delay stop-token observation by up to the existing bounded sleep interval at margins; long-running crawl/map lane interaction has not had a dedicated soak test.
search_registry_identity is recomputed per lease/completion and publication SQL parses JSON per row; possible Debug CPU hot spots are not yet backed by a controlled before/after benchmark.
Offline evaluation/probe/replay tools were not exercised end-to-end in the Windows 11 takeover audit.
MSan/TSan are not configured in upstream CI; ASan/UBSan is covered by the Linux CI workflow.
